subject: Marketplace procurement: evidence package & technical annex request
body:
From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@procureit.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureIT Sourcing <sourcing@procureit.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo earlier — ProcureIT is progressing internal approvals and the marketplace listing team asked for a consolidated procurement evidence package that maps to AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace requirements. They noted we should provide the following items:

- SOC 2 Type II report and summary of controls relevant to multi-tenant inference
- Tenant isolation / encryption architecture diagram and key lifecycle docs
- Billing & metering explanation for marketplace meter types (per-token, embedding units)
- Draft marketplace SLA language and any standard marketplace addenda
- A short technical annex (1–2 pages) that explains how routing/fallback and caching work for Dedicated vs Hosted modes

Can you send a single package (PDF + annex + any zipped evidence) and a reasonable completion ETA? We’re targeting the ProcureIT vendor review on Dec 8.

Best,
Emily Turner
Senior Sourcing Manager, ProcureIT

-----Original Message-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@procureit.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence request

Hi Emily — thanks, we can get that over. I’ll assemble the package and include the technical annex you requested.

ETA: preliminary packet by Mon Nov 29, finalized by Tue Dec 1 (to allow legal to review SLA redlines).

I’ll include: SOC 2 summary + evidence index, architecture diagram (tenant isolation/encryption), metering note, technical annex covering routing/fallback/caching differences for Hosted vs Dedicated, and a draft SLA for marketplace listings.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:30 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence request

Team — forwarding ProcureIT’s ask below. Can each of you confirm the artifacts you can provide by EOD Fri Nov 27 so I can assemble a single package? Please attach drafts where possible.

Karthik — technical annex (routing/fallback/caching) + architecture diagram (tenant isolation/encryption).
Marcus — SOC 2 summary + evidence index; also please attach the latest call-outs for any third-party subprocessors.
Vanessa — draft marketplace SLA, commercial metering language, and any marketplace-specific billing notes.

If you have any blockers (legal redlines, PII in evidence) flag them in your reply and I’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Naomi

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 11:40 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Naomi / team — attaching the initial Technical Annex workbook (Marketplace_Technical_Annex.xlsx). It includes three tabs: routing_policy, cache_behavior, and kv-prefixing_examples.
> 
> Quick summary:
> - Hosted: default routing to verified model variants in the same region; automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated prompt families; latency-optimized kernels selected per model.
> - Dedicated: customers can pin model versions; routing remains policy-driven but without cross-tenant routing; KV caches are per-customer and can be persisted.
> - Fallbacks: policy allows downgrade to quantized variant or regional failover; we include automatic telemetry to surface quality regressions.
> 
> I’ve added a simple diagram and recommended text snippets for the annex. No blockers from infra; the diagram is attached as PNG in the workbook.
> 
> — Karthik

On Thu, Nov 26, 2026 at 08:17 AM, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Team — attaching SOC2 summary and evidence index (SOC2-TypeII-Evidence.zip). Highlights:
> - Scope: inference control plane, telemetry ingestion, and customer-facing APIs (marketplace endpoints included).
> - Controls: encryption at rest (AES-256), TLS 1.3 in transit, role-based access, key rotation cadence documented.
> - Subprocessors: cloud providers (AWS/GCP/Azure), observability vendor (Telemetrix), storage (BlobX).
> 
> Note: legal provided a short PII redaction checklist for attachments — I applied redactions to the sample audit logs. If ProcureIT needs the full reports we should route through secure transfer.
> 
> — Marcus

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 15:22, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Naomi / Karthik / Marcus — I’ve uploaded a draft marketplace SLA with our standard marketplace addendum language and three alternative metering descriptions (per-token, per-embedding, and subscription-tier). Key commercial notes:
> - Marketplace metering is configurable; when listing we recommend per-token + nightly aggregation for enterprise customers to match ProcureIT billing cadence.
> - The draft has redline comments on indemnity and data retention (we should consider a 90-day retention window for marketplace logs by default; customers can request longer retention under Dedicated).
> 
> Attached: draft_marketplace_SLA_redlines.docx
> 
> — Vanessa

-----Original message sent to ProcureIT (final package)-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@procureit.com>
Cc: ProcureIT Sourcing <sourcing@procureit.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace - Onboarding <marketplace-team@aws-partners.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood marketplace evidence package for ProcureIT (attached)

Emily — attaching the consolidated package for ProcureIT’s vendor review:

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Marketplace_Procurement_Packet.pdf (one‑page cover + index + executive summaries)
- Marketplace_Technical_Annex.xlsx (technical annex workbook from Karthik)
- SOC2-TypeII-Evidence.zip (redacted evidence index from Marcus)
- draft_marketplace_SLA_redlines.docx (Vanessa’s redlined SLA)

A few notes:
- We redacted sensitive audit excerpts from the SOC 2 evidence; full reports are available via secure file transfer on request.
- Metering recommendation: per-token with nightly aggregation for ProcureIT’s expected billing cadence; we can switch to embedding-based if you prefer.
- Routing/fallback: Hosted will use cross-region verified variants and prefix/KV caching; Dedicated preserves tenant isolation and offers persisted KV caches. The annex includes example wording you can paste into the marketplace listing.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the Dec 8 vendor review will require anything in addition to the attached packet. If you’re ready we can also send the DocuSign link for the marketplace addendum (I’ve included a placeholder link below).

DocuSign (marketplace addendum): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123
Drive package: https://drive.google.com/naomi/redwood-marketplace-pkg
HubSpot record: HS-20260891

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

-----Reply from ProcureIT (receipt)-----
From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@procureit.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace evidence package for ProcureIT (attached)

Naomi — received, thanks. I’ll circulate to the vendor review team and flag any gaps by Tue Dec 1. If we need the unredacted SOC 2 report we’ll request a secure transfer. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Emily
